purpose: Candidate model families for later hardware-specific evaluation. No model is approved for distribution or automatically downloaded by this registry.

candidates.license_status: verify exact model repository and artifact; do not infer from family name
candidates.hardware_profile: select small quantized variants for low-memory devices; larger variants PC only

candidates.license_status: Llama Community License and acceptable-use terms; review before any redistribution
candidates.hardware_profile: edge/mobile-oriented quantized variants; benchmark on target device
candidates.android_status: official model documentation describes ExecuTorch and mobile/edge use; SuperIA integration not implemented

candidates.license_status: verify exact Gemma 4 model card, terms and prohibited-use policy for chosen artifact
candidates.hardware_profile: separate mobile-optimized small variants from PC variants; measure memory
candidates.android_status: official mobile-oriented quantized artifacts exist; SuperIA integration not implemented
